purpose: Show a compact noninteractive zero-based bar series for dense metrics and cells.
behaviorProvider: Shared Sparkline forced to its bar variant.

component: Always delegate to Sparkline with variant=bar, using mini-bar width and height defaults unless the caller supplies dimensions.
Inherit Sparkline normalization: finite negatives clamp to zero and nonfinite values become zero. Bar heights are zero-based relative to a peak of at least one.
Delegate loading to a named Skeleton status and empty input to a role=img em-dash replacement. General SVG props are only forwarded by Sparkline in its populated branch.
host: Supply a label describing actual units and time/category domain; generic event-count wording may be inaccurate for other quantities.
Provide a detailed chart or exact data elsewhere when users need quantitative comparison. Independent mini bars do not share a common cross-chart scale.

limitations: Signed values and missing-data distinctions are not preserved.
No interaction, exact-value table or data fetching is added by this wrapper.
